payload.safeSummary: The fixed release-bound Psyker ability, Smite action, and charge-template sources retain the 3-second normal charge default under smite_attack_speed=1. This is a template-level source value and does not assert universal runtime timing. Upstream path membership and every cited file identity are bound to commit e840592880fdd5f253c6633e081633808c7e0bd2; this evidence and its claim remain pending review.

At this pinned release, the Brain Burst Improved buff template assigns 1.5 to the Smite damage multiplier. The separate damage branch applies that parameter when damage type is Smite. This supports the bounded source parameter and branch only, not final runtime damage. Upstream path membership and every cited file identity are bound to commit e840592880fdd5f253c6633e081633808c7e0bd2; this evidence and its claim remain pending review.

The fixed release-bound target-locked charge path retains the 2-second sticky-charge default under smite_attack_speed=1; the target-lock branch resets charge timing when its target changes. This is bounded source behavior, not a universal runtime timing claim. Upstream path membership and every cited file identity are bound to commit e840592880fdd5f253c6633e081633808c7e0bd2; this evidence and its claim remain pending review.

The release-bound Smite action and damage-target path retain a 0.25 base Peril parameter on successful damage; an empty cast or miss does not enter that payment branch. This records the parameter and branch only, not measured runtime Peril. Upstream path membership and every cited file identity are bound to commit e840592880fdd5f253c6633e081633808c7e0bd2; this evidence and its claim remain pending review.

The talent definition binds the improved brain-burst description's damage format value to smite_damage_multiplier and applies (value - 1) * 100; the pinned talent layout parser renders the percentage with its configured prefix. With source parameter 1.5, the description-format value is 50 percent. This is a code-derived display parameter, not a final damage value; Steam build and localized-description compatibility are unverified.

At the fixed upstream commit, the damage calculation checks damage_type == damage_types.smite, reads attacker_stat_buffs.smite_damage_multiplier on that branch, and multiplies the parameter into damage_multiplier (lines 506-514). This records the bounded conditional and multiplication relation only; other calculation stages and final damage are not resolved.

At the fixed upstream commit, the psyker_brain_burst_improved template assigns the code literal 1.5 to stat_buffs[stat_buffs.smite_damage_multiplier]. This evidence supports only the parameter value; downstream damage outcome and runtime application are unverified.

At the fixed upstream commit, the psyker_smite_kill damage target in the psyker_smite action uses damage_types.smite (lines 538-562). This links the selected action to the shared calculation branch condition only; it does not establish runtime resolution or final damage.

payload.technicalDefinitionEn: The stat_buffs parameter key used by the Psyker brain-burst-improved buff template. In this pinned source snapshot, the shared damage calculation reads it on the damage_types.smite branch and multiplies it into damage_multiplier; the pinned Psyker Smite action uses that damage type. This bounded linkage does not resolve other calculation stages or a final damage outcome.

積蓄靈能力量，釋放時可對單個敵人造成巨大傷害。

該天賦是可造成{damage:%s}傷害的{talent_old:%s}的加強版。

items.text: 以下數值不含其他加成或減免。
相較於顱腦爆裂，顱腦崩裂傷害提高 50%（1.5 倍）；這項加成不適用於所有靈能攻擊。
顱腦崩裂蓄力時，你會累積反噬；對有效目標觸發攻擊後再增加 25%。
先蓄力再鎖定：未鎖定敵人也能蓄力；鎖定後接續蓄力進度。
直接鎖定蓄力：先鎖定敵人，再蓄力。
鎖定後，移開準星也不會更換目標。
你的反噬從 0% 起算，且蓄力不中斷：
未鎖定預蓄：約 3 秒蓄滿；持續未鎖定時，1／2／3 秒的反噬約 6.67%／13.33%／20%。若中途鎖定，後續改用鎖定階段的累積方式。
直接鎖定蓄力：約 2 秒蓄滿；1／2 秒時，你的反噬約 10%／20%。
未鎖定預蓄已滿並繼續維持時，你的反噬每秒約增加 9 個百分點。
直接鎖定蓄滿後觸發攻擊，或未鎖定預蓄至滿後立即鎖定攻擊，你的反噬約 45%。若在未鎖定的滿蓄狀態多維持 1 秒再攻擊，約 54%；中途鎖定不套用此估算。
若在攻擊觸發前取消蓄力，或觸發時目標已不存在或死亡而未執行攻擊，則不另收取 25% 反噬；蓄力時已累積的反噬仍保留。
以下僅適用於會被顱腦崩裂打出踉蹌的敵人：
直接鎖定：鎖定同一敵人超過 1 秒，顱腦崩裂使其輕微踉蹌一次。
先蓄力再鎖定：鎖定敵人超過 0.25 秒，顱腦崩裂使其輕微踉蹌一次。
